claim.claim-text: 1. A composition comprising an aqueous solution containing

at least one polymerase, wherein the at least one polymerase includes a reverse transcriptase present in the aqueous solution at a concentration of from about 0.1 U/µl to about 0.6 U/µl, a trehalose bulking agent, a detergent, an organic buffer, at least one oligonucleotide useful for performing a molecular assay, deoxynucleotide triphosphates (dNTPs), and less than 0.1 mM magnesium ions.

2. The composition of claim 1, wherein the at least one oligonucleotide is selected from the group consisting of: an amplification oligonucleotide, a detection probe oligonucleotide optionally comprising at least one label, a target capture probe oligonucleotide, an adaptor oligonucleotide, and combinations thereof.
3. The composition of claim 1 or 2, wherein the aqueous solution comprises oligonucleotides for performing a multiplex molecular assay.
4. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the bulking agent is present at a concentration from about 0.16 M to about 0.32 M.
5. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the aqueous solution contains from about 0.196 µg/µl of potassium ions to about 0.010 µg/µl of potassium ions.

6. The composition of any preceding claim, wherein the dNTPs include dATP at a concentration of from 0.1 mM to 0.3 mM in the aqueous solution, dGTP at a concentration of from 0.1 mM to 0.3 mM in the aqueous solution, dCTP at a concentration of from 0.1 mM to 0.3 mM in the aqueous solution, dTTP at a concentration of from 0.2 mM to 0.6 mM in the aqueous solution or dUTP at a concentration of from 0.2 mM to 0.6 mM in the aqueous solution.
7. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the at least one polymerase includes a polymerase that is a hot-start polymerase, optionally

wherein the hot-start polymerase is a recombinant Taq DNA polymerase bound by an antibody that specifically blocks polymerase activity of the polymerase, or wherein the hot-start polymerase is a chemically modified recombinant Taq DNA polymerase, wherein the chemical modification inhibits polymerase activity of the polymerase.
8. The composition of any one claims 1 to 7, wherein the reverse transcriptase is an AMV reverse transcriptase or an MMLV reverse transcriptase.

9. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the aqueous solution further comprises an RNase inhibitor, optionally wherein the RNase inhibitor is present in the aqueous solution at a concentration from about 0.12 U/µl to about 0.20 U/µl.
10. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the aqueous solution further comprises a chelating agent, optionally

wherein the chelating agent is selected from the group consisting of EDTA, EDDS, MGDA, EGTA and DTPA, preferably wherein the chelating agent is EDTA and is present in the aqueous solution at a concentration from 1.5 mM to 2.0 mM.
11. The composition of claim 1 having an inorganic salt concentration of 7 mM or less.
12. A dried form of the composition of any of claims 1 to 11.
13. A method of forming a mixture for use in performing a nucleic acid based amplification reaction, the method comprising

combining a reconstitution solution and the dried composition of claim 12, wherein the reconstitution solution comprises at least one inorganic salt, optionally, wherein the reconstitution solution comprises MgCl<2> at a concentration from about 3.8 mM to about 4.4 mM, KCl at a concentration from about 50 mM to about 80 mM, or both.
14. A method for preparing a dried composition for use in performing a molecular assay, the method comprising the steps of:

(15) freezing an aqueous solution of any one of claims 1 to 11, thereby forming a frozen form of the aqueous solution; and (ii) exposing the frozen form from step (i) to lyophilization conditions, thereby forming a dried composition.
15. A kit for use in performing a molecular assay, the kit comprising

a first vessel containing the dried composition of claim 12, and a second vessel containing a reconstitution solution, wherein the reconstitution solution comprises at least one inorganic salt, suitably MgCl<2>.
